AuthorizationContext.title: AuthorizationContext
AuthorizationContext.description: Caller-supplied decision context: principal facts, membership facts, and known tenants (projected from @epoch/identity and @epoch/tenancy by the host).

AuthorizationRecordVersion.title: AuthorizationRecordVersion
AuthorizationRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized authorization record (currently 1).

PrincipalFact.title: PrincipalFact
PrincipalFact.description: Caller-supplied principal fact: status and authentication state projected from @epoch/identity records by the host.

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque principal id: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/identity).

PrincipalStatus.title: PrincipalStatus
PrincipalStatus.description: Principal status fact (mirrors @epoch/identity): active, suspended, or deactivated.

MembershipFact.title: MembershipFact
MembershipFact.description: Caller-supplied tenancy membership fact: tenant-wide (tenant only), workspace-wide (tenant + workspace), or project-scoped (tenant + workspace + project).

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant id: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).

WorkspaceId.title: WorkspaceId
WorkspaceId.description: Opaque workspace id: "workspace:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).

ProjectId.title: ProjectId
ProjectId.description: Opaque project id: "project:" followed by a lowercase slug (mirrors @epoch/tenancy).
